record_grain: One row per NPI facility record, keyed by the national facility_id; jurisdiction_code + jurisdiction_facility_id is the state-scoped facility identifier pair.
grain_rationale: Byte inspection shows a single header row of 22 flat scalar fields with no nested arrays, so one row is one facility. facility_id is the nationally unique NPI facility identifier; jurisdiction_facility_id is only unique within jurisdiction_code and must never be used alone. Operator identity (registered_business_name, abn, acn) repeats across facility rows and is a separate business role, not a facility key.

record_id.rationale: facility_id is the national NPI facility identifier and is unique across jurisdictions; jurisdiction_code + jurisdiction_facility_id is retained as the state-scoped identifier pair but is not needed for the record key.

fields.rationale: facility_id is the national NPI facility identifier, unique across jurisdictions; establishment-owned, not the operator's ABN/ACN.

State-scoped NPI facility identifier; only unique within its jurisdiction, so the jurisdiction_code qualifier is carried with every claim. The qualifier is passed through verbatim (trim+upper only, no enum mapping) so it is never dropped, including for non-state codes such as 'COM'.

NPI registration jurisdiction of the facility, kept as a free string (trim+upper only, no enum mapping) because the source reportedly contains non-state codes such as 'COM' that a closed AU state enum would silently drop. Distinct from the business address state and required as the qualifier for the jurisdiction-scoped facility id.
facility_name is the site/premises name; it is not unique and must not be conflated with registered_business_name.
latitude/longitude are facility coordinates; geo_point validates the pair lies inside Australia. Values may be rounded and do not assert exact site boundaries.

street_address is the facility site street address; establishment-owned site address claim, not the operator's registered office. Only trim+collapse_whitespace are applied; whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 is not asserted, so a non-breaking space or other non-ASCII whitespace may be preserved in the emitted value (held-out ordinal 373 shows 'HENTY\u00a0HWY\t'). No normalisation beyond trim+collapse_whitespace is claimed.
suburb is the facility site locality; establishment-owned, not the operator's registered locality.

state is the facility site address state; establishment-owned. The NPI registration jurisdiction is captured separately as dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts. The map_enum uses passthrough=false and default=null, so any state value outside the 8-code set is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced; validation shows 115/115 emitted for this snapshot, so the drop is bounded here but not for future snapshots.

postcode is the facility site postcode; establishment-owned. The postcode transform is treated as a 4-digit AU postcode validator; the observed rows are all 4-digit strings, so no re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced here.

Facility-level primary ANZSIC class code as stated by NPI; describes the facility, not the company-wide industry, so it stays establishment-owned. The scheme qualifier 'anzsic2006' is an inference: the source column does not state an ANZSIC edition, so the qualifier is recorded as inferred, not publisher-stated.

Facility-level ANZSIC class label in the publisher's wording; not promoted to the operator. The scheme qualifier 'anzsic2006' is an inference: the source column does not state an ANZSIC edition, so the qualifier is recorded as inferred, not publisher-stated.
Free-text facility activity statement kept verbatim; not converted into an invented industry code.

NPI reporting-year label of the first report; not an incorporation or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

NPI reporting-year label of the most recent report; not a compliance or licence date, and not an observation date: all observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp, so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.
Count of NPI reports for the facility; a report count, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.
NPI identifier of the most recent report; identifies the report, not the facility.

Published report link only; embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier. The website transform is a basic URL sanity check and may normalise the value (e.g. host casing or trailing slash), so the definition is bounded to 'as emitted by the website transform', not byte-for-byte verbatim; the observed emitted values retain the full path segments.

registered_business_name is the operator's registered business name as published, not the facility name. It is not mapped to entity.legal_name because for individuals/partnerships (e.g. 'A C PENTECOST', 'A L & A K BOSSE') a registered business name is not a registered company legal name; this concept keeps the claim scope to 'registered business name as published' and asserts no legal form. Blank in source is treated as missing (no claim emitted), not as an empty name.
Operator ABN; checksum-validated, blank treated as missing. Presence of an ABN does not imply a particular legal form.

Operator ACN; frequently blank and not derived from the ABN. The acn transform checks the checksum and raises ACN_CHECKSUM for invalid values; those values are NOT emitted as valid ACNs (they are recorded as value errors, which is why they appear in error_examples), so the emitted set is checksum-valid only.

The column is named facility_website and observed domains can mismatch the registered business name (e.g. a group domain published against a differently named operator), so this is kept as an establishment-owned 'published facility website' claim and is not asserted to be the operator's own website. The website transform is a basic URL sanity check; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host, so this is not reused as ext.contact.website_domain (which holds a registrable host).

operator.rationale: The registered business name plus ABN/ACN identify the operator entity, which repeats across facility rows; it is a separate business role from the facility establishment. Known limitation: keys join raw trimmed values with no normalization, and ACN is frequently blank (and invalid ACNs are dropped), so the same operator can produce different entity_refs across rows (one with ACN, one without). This fragmentation is documented, not hidden; ABN alone would be more stable but is also not always present.

establishment.rationale: The NPI facility is a physical operating site identified by the national facility_id; it is distinct from the operator business that reports for it.

relationships.rationale: Each NPI facility row states the registered business that operates the facility; the operator is a business role and the facility an establishment role. The edge emits only when both roles emit at least one claim; the single missing edge (114/115) is bounded to a row where the operator role emitted no claim (registered_business_name blank in 3 rows, abn blank in 12 rows), so no operator claim was available to link.

unmapped.reason: Blank in 3 of 115 observed rows (source_present=112/115). Treated as genuinely missing in source rather than a reader/quoting artefact: the reader is a plain UTF-8 comma-delimited parse with no quoting loss observed elsewhere, and blank is mapped to missing (no claim emitted) rather than an empty name. This is the likely cause of the single missing OPERATES_ESTABLISHMENT edge (114/115), since the operator role has no name claim on that row; the edge is bounded to rows where the operator role emits at least one claim.
Blank in 12 of 115 observed rows (source_present=103/115). Blank is mapped to missing (no claim emitted); presence of an ABN is not inferred and no legal form is derived from it.

Blank in 25 of 115 observed rows and checksum-invalid in 2 (ACN_CHECKSUM: 776225038, 000435635). Blank and invalid values are not emitted as valid ACNs. Because the operator entity key joins abn+acn+registered_business_name with no normalisation, the same operator can fragment into multiple entity_refs across rows (with/without ACN); this is a documented identity limitation, not a hidden one.

Mapped through a closed 8-code enum with passthrough=false and default=null. Any state value outside NSW/VIC/QLD/WA/SA/TAS/ACT/NT is dropped (no claim emitted), not coerced. Validation shows 115/115 emitted for this snapshot, so the drop is bounded here but not for future snapshots.

Kept as a free string (trim+upper only, no enum mapping) so non-state codes are preserved. The source reportedly contains a 'COM' code, but no emitted example containing 'COM' is available in the observed snapshot, so the preservation claim is stated as 'source reportedly contains' rather than evidenced.

The scheme qualifier 'anzsic2006' is an inference: the source column does not state an ANZSIC edition. The qualifier is recorded as inferred, not publisher-stated; if NPI uses a different edition the qualifier would be wrong.
The scheme qualifier 'anzsic2006' is an inference: the source column does not state an ANZSIC edition. The qualifier is recorded as inferred, not publisher-stated.

Passed through the website transform, which may normalise the value (e.g. host casing or trailing slash). The definition is bounded to 'as emitted by the website transform', not byte-for-byte verbatim; the observed emitted values retain the full path segments.

Passed through the website transform; the emitted value is a URL string, not reduced to a bare host. The concept is typed string and is not reused as ext.contact.website_domain (which holds a registrable host).

Mapped with trim+collapse_whitespace only. Whether collapse_whitespace normalises U+00A0 is not asserted; a non-breaking space or trailing tab may be preserved in the emitted value (held-out ordinal 373 shows 'HENTY\u00a0HWY\t'). No normalisation beyond trim+collapse_whitespace is claimed.
Mapped through the postcode transform, treated as a 4-digit validator. No re-padding of 3-digit values is claimed or evidenced in the observed rows.

A reporting-year label, not an observation date. All observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp (observed_at falls back to retrieved_at, 2026-11-22T22:37:19+00:00), so this label must not be read as when the record was observed.

A reporting-year label, not an observation date. All observations in a snapshot share the retrieval timestamp (observed_at falls back to retrieved_at, 2026-11-22T22:37:19+00:00), so this label must not be read as when the record was observed or updated.

notes: All 22 columns are read. state is mapped to dyn.establishment.state for the facility site address while jurisdiction_code is captured separately as the NPI registration jurisdiction (free string, no enum mapping, so 'COM' is preserved); the two are near-duplicates for the observed rows but are not guaranteed equal. facility_id is the record key; jurisdiction_facility_id is only unique within jurisdiction_code and is never used alone. registered_business_name/abn/acn belong to the operator business role, not the facility; no legal form or entity_type is inferred from names or ABN presence. registered_business_name is mapped to dyn.business.registered_business_name, not entity.legal_name, because a registered business name is not a registered company legal name. facility_website is mapped to establishment-owned dyn.establishment.published_website, not entity.website, because the domain may be a group/facility site. first_report_year/latest_report_year are NPI reporting-year labels, not incorporation or licence dates. primary_anzsic_class_* describe the facility's primary activity, not a company-wide industry classification. reports is a report count, not an emissions measure, and the facilities table alone does not evidence emissions or environmental compliance. latest_report_url is a link, not a stable identifier. observed_at has no publisher-stated modification column, so the resource_last_modified fallback resolves to retrieved_at (2026-11-22T22:37:19+00:00): this is observation-at-retrieval, not a publisher-stated update. No constants are used.
